about: One record per summer, 2008-2026. Areas in m2. Every value says what kind it is. 'calc_run1' is a first satellite count that is NOT validated (known errors); it is hidden by default on the page.

events.text: First covers on the Presena glacier (and on the Diavolezza ski run).

years.documented_note: Cover along the ski-lift line and the central 'knee' (AINEVA, Neve e Valanghe 74).

Laid 28 June, removed 14 September (PhD thesis UniMi 2013, which gives about 70,000 m²); about 52% less ablation under the cover; albedo 0.64 on the cover vs 0.43 on the glacier; a step of about 1.5–2 m at the end of summer.

events.text: Materials test at about 2,765 m: up to 69% less melt.
Traditional cover (TenCate Toptex GLS 340, reused) has albedo about 0.43–0.44, like the glacier; experimental fabrics cut melt by 62–94% (PhD thesis UniMi 2013).

years.note: Sentinel-2 starts (June 2015). Late-summer scenes exist; not yet counted.

years.reported_note: 'More than 100,000 m²' (Betti and Fleck 2021, with materials from the operator).

years.calc_note: Training year of the classifier: the most favourable case.

events.text: Used sheets shown at the Venice Architecture Biennale, according to the operator.
About 34 t of fabric on the mountain; 17 t a year sent to the Bolzano waste-to-energy plant; sheets used for two seasons (Betti and Fleck 2021).

years.calc_flag: Anomalous: larger than any claimed year. Likely cloud or snow counted as fleece. To check by eye.
Anomalous: scene error or real change. To check by eye.

calc_run1_about: Random forest on Sentinel-2 L1C, trained on 2021-08-14 (fleece, ice, shadow); sunlit debris had no class; area of interest 1.51 km2. Run on 2026-11-04. Not validated.

pending_tests.label: LiDAR 2006-09
pending_tests.text: First province-wide LiDAR. If flown over Presena before summer 2008, it is the surface before the covers. Flight date to check.

pending_tests.label: LiDAR 2014 / 2018
pending_tests.text: Second LiDAR. Differencing with 2006-09 tests claim C09 (uncovered ice 11 m lower after six seasons). A step of about 1.5-2 m after the single summer 2010 is documented (AINEVA).

before_2008.text: White geotextiles were already laid on the right-hand side of the glacier at the end of the 1990s, after straw mulching and moved or artificial snow, to keep the ski lifts to Passo Presena running (AINEVA, Neve e Valanghe 74).

glacier_area_ha.about: Presena Occidentale glacier area (AINEVA, Neve e Valanghe 74, citing the 1961 CGI cadastre, PAT and SAT).
